job.heading: Careforce AI (YC F24) — Senior Fullstack Engineer 🟢
job.experience: 5–7+ years (may flex for strong AI skills)
job.why_fit: The stack is a near-perfect overlay — Python, FastAPI, React deployed for healthcare AI agents. Entire company is organized around agent teams (Agent Experience, Agent Interfaces, Agent Alignment, Agent Deployment). Base salary starts borderline but bonuses and early-stage equity (0.2–1.0%) push total comp well above threshold.
job.summary: YC-backed healthcare AI startup building autonomous AI agents for healthcare administrative tasks. ~10 employees, rapid growth.
job.company_context: Careforce AI (previously HelpCare AI) is a YC F24 company with ~10 employees building autonomous AI agents that handle healthcare administrative tasks like prior authorizations, claims processing, and patient scheduling. The company is organized into four agent-focused teams: Agent Experience, Agent Interfaces, Agent Alignment, and Agent Deployment. As an early-stage YC company, they value builders who can own entire features end-to-end. Their tech stack centers on Python/FastAPI backends with React frontends, Supabase for data, and GCP for infrastructure. The healthcare admin automation space is massive — prior authorizations alone cost the US healthcare system $35B+ annually in administrative waste.

weak_spots: React: Job requires React but fact set contains only TypeScript/JavaScript without explicit React framework experience
Supabase: Job lists Supabase but facts only mention pgvector, Chroma without Supabase-specific experience
GCP: Job lists GCP but facts do not specify cloud platform used
